-- Salesforce connector: connection, sync cursor and raw payload tables.

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "salesforce_connection" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "orgId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "salesforce_connection_org_idx" ON "salesforce_connection" ("orgId");

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "salesforce_sync_cursor" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "orgId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "salesforce_sync_cursor_org_idx" ON "salesforce_sync_cursor" ("orgId");

-- Salesforce events land in event with source = 'salesforce'.
-- Partial index for the connector's timeline query.

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS event_salesforce_connection_occurred_idx
  ON event ("connectionId", "occurredAt")
  WHERE source = 'salesforce';

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "salesforce_connection_created_idx" ON "salesforce_connection" ("createdAt");
